classification.difficultyReason: Construct two distinct rectangles for each perimeter, including a perimeter requiring decimal side lengths.

content.prompt: For each part below, draw two different rectangles with the given perimeter.

answer.short: Sample answers: $6\text{ cm}\times4\text{ cm}$ and $7\text{ cm}\times3\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked:
Sample rectangles are shown below. Add all four sides to check each perimeter.
$$\begin{align*}P_1&=6+4+6+4\\P_1&=20\text{ cm}\\P_2&=7+3+7+3\\P_2&=20\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
